thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered -> high 5xx rate on apigw-eu-west (502/504). Escalation: P1. Paging oncall.
maria: Noticed sudden jump ~08:12 UTC, error rate ~18% for last 3m, affects /v1/generate primarily.
raj: I'm oncall — looking at dashboards now. Tagging infra team.
kevin: Confirming: haproxy stats show rapid increase in queued connections + SO_REUSE errors on edge nodes euw-12..15.
maria: No deploys in the window from CI. Host-level metrics: conntrack table climbing, tcp_resets rising.
kevin: Upstream inference-gateway pods returning 502 from envoy. Timeouts not consistent with CPU; socket limits look hit.
lucy-sre: Suspect L4 exhaustion / long-lived keepalives. Recommend reducing keepalive and bumping proxy_max_sess temporarily.
taylor: Can we do a quick traffic shift to us-west-2 for latency-insensitive routes? Need to check customer impact (EU customers may see latency bump).
eng_prod: No scheduled maintenance. Traffic-shift playbook ready. Suggest 20% -> us-west-2 as a canary.
support: We already have a spike in support channels for "502" errors from EU customers. CS notified major accounts.
raj: Rolling config change: reduce keepalive from 75s -> 15s on edge-proxy pool A. Rolling now 1/3.
kevin: Patching conntrack: increased hashsize on the fly where possible. Also reloading haproxy with soft-restart.
maria: Applying traffic shift 20% to us-west-2 now via global-router toggle. Monitoring.
incident-bot: Action logged: keepalive-reduced, traffic-shift=20% -> us-west-2. Runbook steps in /inc/triage/1798001234
lucy-sre: After keepalive change, socket frees increased, tcp_resets dropping.
taylor: Error rate down to 8% after shift and keepalive change (2m). Still above baseline.
kevin: Spotted one faulty router that kept opening connections: euw-14. Draining euw-14 now.
maria: Draining euw-14. Marked node for deeper network debug and kernel options review.
eng_prod: Fallback routing holding fine. No cascade observed. CDN edge unaffected.
support: Monitoring support queue. Prioritized customers: Acme Corp + BetaApps; notified both of mitigation steps.
raj: Increasing traffic shift to 35% while we watch for stability. Will not exceed 50% without leadership sign-off.
incident-bot: Change logged: traffic-shift=35% -> us-west-2.
maria: At 35% shift error rate trending 3.4% (5m). Latency up ~40ms for shifted sessions.
taylor: Recommend keeping shift until euw nodes cleared. Can we auto-heal euw-14 after kernel tuning?
kevin: Kernel and sysctl changes applied to euw nodes pool, conntrackGC tuned. Reprovisioning euw-14 into service in 5m.
lucy-sre: Reintegrated euw-14 -> nodes back to pool. Watching for regression.
maria: Error rate stabilized ~1.2% now. Most traffic served from euw healthy nodes + partial us-west-2.
eng_prod: No data loss, just degraded responses (502s). Postmortem flagged: root cause likely L4 socket exhaustion due to conntrack/keepalive interaction.
raj: Handoff to next shift at 09:00 UTC. Action items: (1) postmortem, (2) permanent keepalive tuning, (3) add conntrack alerts, (4) review haproxy limits.
support: Will prepare customer postmortem note draft. Assigning follow-up with BetaApps and Acme.
incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated. Incident channel archived with summary. Severity downgraded to P2 for follow-up.
summary: 502/504 spike in eu-west caused by L4 socket/conntrack exhaustion; mitigated by reducing keepalive, draining faulty node, and shifting traffic to us-west-2. Follow-ups: postmortem and permanent sysctl/haproxy tuning.
